metadata.title: EnvCoRe-SW public release validation code
metadata.description: Version 2.0.0 validates the current 20,023-record EnvCoRe-SW public payload and, under a separate explicit profile, its 24-file release-candidate QA structure. It checks integrity controls, dictionaries, controlled vocabularies, aggregate validation outputs, and disclosure boundaries using only the Python standard library. It contains no private source reports, crosswalks, source paths, source text, reviewer identities, or private adjudication ledgers.
metadata.notes: The new code-version DOI is intentionally not prefilled because Zenodo assigns it at deposit. The associated new dataset-version DOI is not guessed and may be added after assignment.
